messages.subject: ggfluctuation deprecated?
parts:
I use ggfluctuation because it offers a much more intuitive visualisation of some types of data that might otherwise be plotted as heatmaps. 
Information on it is very sparse, both online and in help files. Recently it has started to complain it is "deprecated". No information is given as to what, if anything it was replace by. Can anyone enlighten me?
